messages:
sophia: Kicking off coordination for the Zurich marketplace go-live (eu-zh-1). Need quotas, partner capacity confirmation, marketplace SKU approvals, and a billing smoke test. Can CloudWave confirm GPU roster and timing?

nina-partner: Hi all — CloudWave can provision 4x A100s in the Zurich site initially but sustained capacity requires ELA sign-off. I can open the allocation request today.

omar: Thanks. Do we have a final marketplace SKU to wire to billing? Need to avoid mismatches in the listing.

sophia: For now use placeholder sku RW-INF-EU-ZH-001. Omar, can you coordinate with finance to map that to our billing ID?

liam: From infra: networking/peering will be required. We need partner CIDR, ASN, and an expected maintenance window. Also confirm whether the site supports direct VPC peering or if it's NAT-only.

partners-eng: I'll take networking. Can someone share the CloudWave contact for routing?

nina-partner: Sending contact — marco.cloudwave@cloudwave.example (cc:marco). He handles peering. Marco said they'll provide ASN and BGP configs within 48h once we submit the ticket.

jana: Legal flag: Switzerland data residency clause needs to be in the marketplace T&Cs addendum. I'll draft an addendum and loop in compliance. Targeting a draft by EOD Thursday.

sophia: Proposed timeline: submit quota & ELA request today -> partner capacity confirmed by Thu -> marketplace listing ready by next Tue -> smoke test by following Fri. Thoughts?

liam: Main risk: on-demand A100s in Zurich may be contention-prone. Recommend adding automated region fallback to eu-west-2 for the first two weeks of launch as a safety net and a canary route for 10% traffic.

sophia: Good call. Let's add fallback routing to the plan.

sophia: Action items (owner - ETA):
- nina-partner: submit capacity ticket + ELA request (due +5 business days)
- partners-eng: collect peering details and CIDR from Marco (due 48h)
- jana: draft T&C addendum for CH residency (due Thu EOD)
- liam: implement fallback routing and smoke test runbook (due next Tue)
- omar: confirm SKU -> billing mapping with finance (due tomorrow)

nina-partner: Ticket submitted: CW-9921, description: Zurich capacity request (4x A100); ETA for ELA review 5 business days.

marketplace-bot: Ticket created: CW-9921 | CloudWave Zurich capacity | Status: Pending ELA review | Created by nina-partner

omar: Looping in @sarah-finance to confirm billing mapping for RW-INF-EU-ZH-001.

sarah-finance: Got it, will validate mapping and pricing cadence by EOD tomorrow.

liam: I'll prepare the smoke test runbook and include metrics to validate latency and token throughput. Will post checklist in #eng-sre.

partners-eng: Reached out to Marco for ASN + CIDR. He said peering window next Wednesday, needs our peering VLAN + contact details.

sophia: Standup scheduled tomorrow 09:30 UTC to check blockers. Please update ticket CW-9921 with any changes and drop quick status updates here. :calendar:

sophia: Thanks everyone — ping me directly if you hit blockers. :sparkles:
